title: Prediction and betting odds for Lakers vs. Kings
text:
Lakers vs. Kings: Prediction, picks, odds Rumors Stats Odds Betting Newsletter Shop LAKERS Prediction and betting odds for Lakers vs. Kings
 Robert Marvi Lakers Wire Nov. 20, 2026, 11:01 a.m. PT The Los Angeles Lakers host the Sacramento Kings on Friday, and if you’re looking to do some last-minute betting research, you’re in luck! We’ll give you the latest point spread, money line odds and over/under number, as well as the information you’ll need to make the smartest bet.
 The Lakers' nine-game winning streak is history. They lost to the Utah Jazz by a final score of 109-97 on Wednesday , as they suffered from a bout of cold shooting. While Luka Doncic went 10-of-28 from the field and 2-of-12 from 3-point range, he was far from the only one who couldn't put the ball in the basket with regularity. As a team, the Lakers shot 38.2% overall and went 9-of-33 from downtown against Utah.
 They will go up against a Kings team that is on the bottom of the Western Conference standings at 1-13 but has a hotshot rookie in Darius Acuff Jr. who can do plenty of damage.
 The lines, courtesy of BetMGM
 Point spread: Lakers -14.5
 Love crosswords? Explore the Crossword page and play the new MidGrid Crossword. Money line: Kings +650/ Lakers -1000
 Over-under: 229.5
 Lakers vs Kings injury reports
 Kings: De'Andre Hunter (left hip soreness/tightness0 is questionable. Precious Achiuwa (left lower leg contusion) is doubtful. Maxime Raynaud (right patella subluxation) and Ben Simmons (right Achilles tendon repair/surgery) are out.
 Lakers: Austin Reaves (left heel contusion/bone bruise) is out.
 Advice and Prediction:
 The Lakers will likely look to use the Kings as a proverbial punching bag in order to get back on track. They will have to contain Acuff, who is averaging 26.2 points and seven assists a game this season but shot 8-of-24 against them when they defeated Sacramento 116-103 earlier this season.
 As usual, expect the Lakers to be aggressive defensively on the perimeter, look to force turnovers and turn turnovers into easy transition baskets. They rank first in opponents' turnover percentage and points off turnovers per game, and they're also sixth in fast-break points per game.
 As long as Doncic regains enough of his shooting touch, this should be a win for Los Angeles. But perhaps it would be wise to not pick L.A. to cover the spread, as it shot poorly overall in its win over the Charlotte Hornets on Tuesday and has had trouble holding leads late in games.
 Prediction: Lakers 116, Kings 107
